sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Deep Learning Multi-Modal Fusion: Methods ...
sources.snippet: This paper comprehensively reviews existing methods based on multi-modal fusion techniques and completes a detailed and in-depth analysis. According to the data fusion stage, multi-modal fusion has four primary methods: early fusion, deep fusion, late fusion, and hybrid fusion.

sources.title: Multimodal Alignment and Fusion: A Survey - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract This survey provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in multimodal alignment and fusion within the field of machine learning, driven by the increasing availability and diversity of data modalities such as text, images, audio, and video.

sources.title: Multimodal fusion techniques: Review, data representation, information ...
sources.snippet: The paper contributes to the ongoing research in multimodal data fusion, narrowing the field of study to text and image fusion by providing an overview of unimodal and multimodal data representation, multimodal fusion models, pre-trained models, big multimodal datasets, and various task domains.
